playwright.description: Local browser automation for UI verification.

chrome-devtools.description: Performance traces, console and network debugging. Needs Chrome.

github.description: Read-only GitHub repos, issues, PRs and Actions. Needs Docker and a fine-grained token.

supabase.description: Supabase database and docs. Keep read_only=true and scope to a dev project.

mobile-mcp.description: iOS/Android simulator, emulator and device automation. Needs Xcode or ADB. Telemetry disabled.

deepwiki.description: Free: AI docs and Q&A for any public GitHub repository. No account.

microsoft-learn.description: Free: Microsoft, Azure and .NET docs search and code samples. No account.

aws-knowledge.description: Free: AWS documentation and guidance. No AWS credentials; rate limited.

exa.description: Free tier: web search and page fetch without an API key (rate limited).

next-devtools.description: Free: Next.js 16+ dev-server errors, routes, logs and version-matched docs. Telemetry disabled.

shadcn.description: Free: browse, search and install shadcn/ui components. Writes component files into the project.

21st.description: 21st.dev component catalog and UI generation. Needs a free API key in API_KEY_21ST; search is free, component retrieval and generation are paid; prompts are sent to 21st.dev.

getlayers.description: Paid: GetLayers design library (templates, 3D scenes, palettes, fonts) returned as project source. Requires a Full Stack Lifetime subscription; browser sign-in, no API key.

ripwire.description: Free, local: ranked code maps, call graph, blast radius, tests-to-run and quality deltas (Red Hat). Install the pinned v0.6.7 release binary on PATH first.

git.description: Free: read, search and modify the local Git repository (can commit and switch branches). Needs uv.

sentry.description: Production errors and traces (official, OAuth). No read-only mode: approve each tool call.

grafana.description: Grafana dashboards, metrics and logs (official). Needs uv. Write tools disabled.

semgrep.description: Static analysis via the Semgrep CLI (install Semgrep first).
